name: Permanent Residence Permit

requirement_groups.name: Standard route (work, family with Norwegian/Nordic citizen, other)

requirements.blocker_text: 3 years of continuous residence under a qualifying permit (work immigration, family immigration with a Nordic/Norwegian citizen, or other non-protection permit types), with no permit gap exceeding 3 months total.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of continuous qualifying residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Cannot have been outside Norway for more than 7 months in total during the 3-year qualifying period (up to 15 months allowed for skilled workers if at least 8 of those months were employer-sponsored travel).
Must meet a financial self-support requirement, updated as of 26 March 2024 -- exact current figures were not confirmed to tier-1 precision in this pass.

requirement_groups.name: Asylum, humanitarian grounds, or family of refugees

requirements.blocker_text: 5 years of continuous residence for asylum-based permits, humanitarian-grounds permits, or family members of refugees, with no more than 10 months' total absence.

evidence_required.document: Proof of continuous qualifying residence (3 or 5 years)
Travel records showing absences within the allowed limit

sources.title: UDI -- Calculating the residence period for permanent residence permits: 3-year (work/Nordic-family/other) vs 5-year (asylum/humanitarian/refugee-family) tracks, absence limits (7 vs 10 months), 3-month maximum permit gap, skilled-worker travel exception

UDI -- Permanent residence permit: references a financial self-support requirement (updated 26 March 2024) and Norwegian language/social studies test changes effective 1 July 2025, without full text reproduced on the fetched page

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Norway). The UDI summary page referenced a Norwegian-language and social-studies test requirement for PERMANENT RESIDENCE specifically (distinct from the citizenship-level B1 test in no_naturalisation.json), effective from 1 July 2025, but the fetched content did not include the specific level or hours required -- not modeled as a separate hard requirement to avoid asserting an unconfirmed figure; disclosed here as a real gap. citizenship_after_months (36) reflects PR holders needing to reach no_naturalisation.json's 8-year (96-month) standard bar, with the 3 (or 5) years already spent as temporary/PR-qualifying residence counting toward it -- not independently confirmed as a stacking rule, treated as a reasonable approximation consistent with this dataset's general convention.
